title: An Efficacy Trial of an Intervention Program for Children Exposed to Intimate Partner Violence.
finding: ITT analyses found reduced internalizing problems for girls at follow-up; per-protocol analyses favored treatment for boys and girls immediately after treatment.
limitation: Benefits varied by analysis and sex; completer effects should not replace the more qualified ITT findings. Masking and attrition are not established here.
approvalAction: A contemporaneous protocol or allocation schedule must establish the random mechanism and reconcile five-family blocks here with six-family blocks in the follow-up. Do not approve the frozen revision meanwhile.
